items.name: Wellington Mind Games 2021

venue.name: [ASB Sports Centre](http://wellington.govt.nz/recreation/get-active-indoors/asb-sports-centre)
venue.address: 72 Kemp St, Kilbirnie, Wellington 6022, New Zealand

items.information: Wellington Mind Games 2021 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. It is focused on some of the more mentally demanding events, that are given less of a focus in normal competitions - blindfolded and fewest moves solving, specifically. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience or skill. There will also be event-based time limits in place, to ensure we stay on schedule, especially given the time taken by fewest moves solving. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations. **The main event of this competition is Fewest Moves**

items.name: Altona Algorithms 2021

venue.name: Mount St Joseph Girl's College
venue.address: Cnr Civic Parade and Galvin St, Altona VIC, 3018, Australia

items.information: ## This competition has been cancelled due to the COVID-19 outbreak! ![](https://i.imgur.com/ZIPeEfV.png) **Important notes:** Please take the time to read the FAQ tab, even if you have previously competed. To ensure this is a COVID-safe environment, things will be done differently and there will be additional conditions in place. Please note there is a strict density limit at the venue and competitors may only bring **ONE** guest. If you feel sick, stay at home. If you are exhibiting cold or flu-like symptoms consistent with COVID-19, you will not be permitted in the venue. We are not responsible for any illness you may contract from the competition. **Contact us** We are on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingAustralia/) and [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/speedcubingau/)! [Speedcubing Australia Website](https://speedcubing.org.au)
